title: Koh Samet: the sandcastle, fixed
kaylee: Her channel always fills the moat (if it stops just short, the sand gives way), a moat dug round twinkles and cheers, every bucket has to be filled with sand she digs before it flips, Daddy is buried in a few rubs and sneezes himself out, and the whole beach digs on her iPhone.
questions: Buckets need filling with sand before they flip: keep it?
